rationale: Pre-registered before observing new results. Nine randomized complete blocks for small/noisy points (enough for a one-sided sign test at p<0.01 if all blocks agree); seven blocks for large-footprint points to bound campaign time. Five internal trials per process; process median is the experimental unit. The mandatory known_vec setup/hot/body modes replace the historically overwritten raw files with new, separately preserved measurements, never as a claim about the lost data.
